values: MBTA subway delay risk by commute hour
Share of comparable stop events more than five minutes late. Study days: 90 public MBTA performance files.
Evidence for hourly controls: Red changes +12.9 pp from 7-8 to 8-9 AM, then +8.4 pp from 4-5 to 5-6 PM.
Source: MBTA LAMP daily performance data, derived in data/processed/line_hour_performance.csv. Local time: America/New_York. A late stop is more than 5 minutes behind schedule.
